arm_declaration.checkpoint_compatibility: same parameter shape does not make arms interchangeable: a checkpoint trained under one layout must never be resumed or evaluated under the other; r30_train.encode this by carrying the arm and layout inside the freeze record that the save/restore contract compares
arm_declaration.only_difference: the definition of feature column 12 (index 11); the other 18 columns, their order, the tape schema, the mask semantics, the controller, the trainer and every hyperparameter are shared code

round29_semantic_registry.ack_note: layout comm-send-state/2 (23 dims with ACK features) is orthogonal: this prototype is the 19-dim /1 shape with one changed column; if an ACK build is ever done it would combine the two changes under a new layout name, never silently.
round29_semantic_registry.compatibility_rule: a checkpoint, optimizer state or replay buffer produced under comm-send-state/1 must be refused rather than silently reused under this layout: the same input dimension does not make the same weights. This round registers the requirement only; no production resume/eval entry point was modified and none is claimed to be verified.
